'listed' on each year is how many players the source names that year (winner included). The detroitpslbasketball.com page names no runners-up for 1981-2007 (2006 comes from BCAM's vote totals) and only some for 2008-10, so finalists from those years are missing until another source fills them in. points: total voting points when the source gives them.
